subject: Order form addendum merge — proposed redline timeline & deliverables
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ashley Li <ashley.li@novuscloud.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Order form addendum merge — proposed redline timeline & deliverables

Hi Ashley,

Thanks again for the renewal meeting yesterday. Per our discussion, Novus is moving forward with the 24-month renewal + a capacity uplift to support the extra ingestion pipeline. To keep signoff tight we propose merging the new addendum into the existing order form and handling a single MSA sidecar instead of separate SOWs.

Attached is the latest Redwood OrderForm_v3.pdf with tracked fields (capacity tiers, pricing rows, effective dates). Can you take an initial pass with your legal team on the specific language in Section 2 (Term & Auto-Renew) and Exhibit E (Usage tiers)?

Proposed timeline (our side):
- Today (EOD): Novus sends initial redline to Redwood legal
- +48 hours: Redwood legal returns consolidated comments
- +72 hours: Mutual final redline and DocuSign envelope

Can you confirm Novus can target that pace? If the procurement team needs longer, tell us which clauses you expect to redline so we can prioritize.

Attachments: Redwood_OrderForm_v3.pdf (order form + exhibit)

Thanks — looping in Ben (legal) and Marissa (CS) to keep billing and onboarding aligned. Aditya is on standby for technical confirmation for the capacity language.

Best,

Kimberly Park
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

--
Redwood Inference | Developer-first inference platform — production SLAs, predictable throughput
From: Ashley Li <ashley.li@novuscloud.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@novuscloud.com
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 11:05:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Order form addendum merge — proposed redline timeline & deliverables

Kimberly —

Thanks. Novus legal can meet an accelerated timeline but we have a couple of asks up front so we don’t ping-pong: 

1) The renewal term language currently references a 24-month fixed term but earlier commercial emails mentioned a 12-month ramp + option to extend. Can you confirm the business intention (we want the signing docs to reflect what Finance approves).

2) We will redline Section 7 (Data retention & logging) to align with our SOC profile — we expect to request an audit log retention change and a narrow data processing definition.

I’m attaching Novus_Proposed_Redline.docx — it’s the clean redline with our preferred clause edits. Please have Ben review and flag anything that Redwood cannot accept.

Also CC’ing procurement for scheduling approvals. We can target the +48/+72 cadence if Redwood legal can be responsive.

Thanks,

Ashley Li
Senior Contracts Manager, NovusCloud
ashley.li@novuscloud.com
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ashley Li <ashley.li@novuscloud.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 14:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Order form addendum merge — proposed redline timeline & deliverables

Ashley — thanks for the quick turn.

To confirm: commercial agreed on 24 months with a 12-month minimum performance review / optional extension at the 12-month mark. We’ll add a short commercial note to the order form Exhibit ensuring the optional extension mechanics are spelled out (notification window, pricing treatment).

Ben, Marissa — can you prioritize review of Novus_Proposed_Redline.docx? Two priority items from Ashley: (a) term mechanics (b) Section 7 data retention. If we can turn around Ben’s consolidated comments within 48 hours we should be able to keep to DocuSign by Thursday.

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Ashley Li <ashley.li@novuscloud.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 19 Aug 2026 09:02:23 -0700
Subject: Re: Order form addendum merge — proposed redline timeline & deliverables

Kimberly / Ashley —

Thanks for the materials. I reviewed Novus_Proposed_Redline.docx and attached a consolidated markup (Redwood_markup_v2.docx) with line comments. High-level notes: 

- Term language: we can accept the 24-month term with an explicit 12-month review/extension option. I added hybrid language in Section 2.1 clarifying notice windows (60 days) and the pricing reset mechanics tied to the capacity tier chosen at renewal.
- Data retention (Section 7): we can narrow the processing definition but cannot accept a blanket change that materially increases retention obligations. Proposed compromise: 90-day audit-log retention by default, option to extend with a Paid Add-on. I marked the exact redline.
- Liability cap: we flagged a carve-out request in 11.4 around payment processors — we propose to keep the standard cap but accept a narrow exception for gross negligence only.

If Novus legal can confirm redlines on the three bullets above we’ll do a final pass and produce a clean copy for signoff. I can return a clean consolidated PDF within 24 hours of confirmation.

Attachments: Redwood_markup_v2.docx (tracked comments)

Ben Carter
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
From: Ashley Li <ashley.li@novuscloud.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@novuscloud.com, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Aug 2026 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Order form addendum merge — proposed redline timeline & deliverables

Ben / Kimberly —

Appreciate the quick turnaround. Novus accepts the compromise on the term mechanics and 90-day default for audit logs (we’ll use the paid add-on route if we need longer retention). Regarding the liability carve-out, procurement pushed back on expanding gross negligence exceptions — they asked that language remain symmetrical. We can accept Redwood’s narrow gross negligence carve-out limited to payment processors only; procurement will confirm in their clean signoff this evening.

We’ve cleaned the document and prepared the DocuSign envelope — link below. If Redwood can deliver the final consolidated clean copy by EOD we’ll execute tonight.

DocuSign: https://docusign.com/abcdef1234567890

Thanks — Marissa, Kim, Ben: please confirm final copy and I’ll instruct procurement to release the signature.

Best,

Ashley Li
Senior Contracts Manager, NovusCloud
ashley.li@novuscloud.com
